title: DRIM-ANN: An Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search Engine based on Commercial DRAM-PIMs
problem: ANNS is I/O-intensive and memory-demanding; CPUs bottlenecked by I/O, GPUs limited by memory capacity
motivation: RAG, recommendation systems need efficient large-scale ANNS; traditional architectures unsuitable for billion-scale datasets
method: DRIM-ANN engine optimized for UPMEM DRAM-PIM: approximation tuning, lookup table replacement for squaring, load-balancing, I/O optimization
key_novelty: First ANNS engine targeting commercial DRAM-PIM; systematic optimization for low-power embedded processors within DRAM banks
contributions: DRIM-ANN ANNS engine for DRAM-PIM architecture
limitations: Limited processor power in DRAM banks constrains compute; evaluation on UPMEM platform only
